note: Machine-readable provenance of app_data.json layers (A4). Human narrative: docs/METHODS_RU.md. 'reproducible' = whether a committed script regenerates the layer; derived co-occurrence layers were produced upstream and are NOT reproducible from this repo.

edges.method: person-to-person co-mention; weight = proximity-weighted association strength (PMI-like, not a raw count)
edges.reason: no generator committed; decay function and normalization not recoverable

language_edges.method: language co-mention with positional weighting (in-page location, page breaks not penalized); strong links weight >= 10
language_edges.reason: no generator committed; exact positional formula not recoverable

semantic_links.method: normalized similarity (score 0..1) over shared features; 'shared' = count of shared co-occurring items
semantic_links.reason: exact similarity metric and normalization not recoverable

video_catalog.related_entities.method: curated edges plus transcript-linked edges (src='transcript') with first-mention timecode t

authority.method: Wikidata alignment with VIAF/GND/GeoNames; src='wikidata-auto' (auto) or 'manual'
